title: Lexicographically Smallest Permutation
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq N\leq2\times10^5; 1\leq P_i\leq N\ (1\leq i\leq N); P_i\neq P_j\ (1\leq i<j\leq N); 1\leq A_i\leq N\ (1\leq i\leq N); A_i\neq A_j\ (1\leq i<j\leq N); All input values are integers.
